rule: Melee hit in Entity::attack, source order: damage applied (HP written first); special weapon effects; knockback only for webbed, greased, golem smash, rebound or gnome-pick hits, guarded by a 30-tick knock lock; local player shake by tier (hit 0.1 and 10, block 0.05 and 5, golem smash 0.2 and 20); damage tier from weapon multiplier (1.15 stronger, 0.85 weaker) and charge; enemy bar then damage pop (per hit, not summed); impact sound 28 (776 block, 407-409 whip); bleed roll adds gibs and decal. Camera shake decays per game tick with x and y filters and a cvar cap.
keep: 30-tick knock lock per victim so a crowd cannot chain knocks
Knock only on special states (webbed, greased, golem smash, rebound), not on every hit
Damage tier from weapon multiplier and charge: size of pop encodes the tier
Additive per-hit shake with a cap, and a smaller shake for a block
Two-filter shake decay with an explicit cap
change: Our own numbers held as data per weapon family
Knock decision in src/fight; shake, pop, sound and decal stay client-only
Cap damage pops at 3 per victim for three-attacker fights at 375 wide
Snap y shake to zero (donor does not)
Cap monster knock velocity and zero it when the lock ends (donor does not)
look_test: Style flag on the existing fight scene with a block, a normal hit and a charged hit, plus one webbed target. Show pop size per tier, camera shake at 0.05, 0.1 and 0.2 scaled to phone, and knock only on the webbed target. Check on 375 wide: tiers readable by size alone; a second knock is blocked for 30 ticks. Target src/fight/hit-impact.ts, row 10. No release rows, no lock; Deploy publishes to /preview/.
licence_note: BSD 2-Clause (LICENSE.txt line 3; copyright line 5, Turning Wheel LLC). Adapt code with notice kept. Art, sound and the number curve are not in the repo; the game asset rights holder is not named in the repo. Keep to category-level inspiration and name our own sound and sprite keys.
not_read: Game art, sprites, sounds, music and the pop sprite sheets (absent from the repo)
Gib spray spawn in actgib.cpp beyond the pop path
actmonster.cpp attack state machine beyond the hit-timer assignments and the knock velocity function
lang/en.txt and compendium strings (not needed for the feel)
Third-party licence texts in the repo root
